question: According to the Jujutsu Kaisen wiki, who is taller, Yuta Okkotsu or Megumi Fushiguro? Give both heights.
answer:
**Megumi Fushiguro is taller.** As I recall the wiki, Megumi is 175 cm (5'9") and Yuta Okkotsu is 168 cm (5'6").

I couldn't check this against the Jujutsu Kaisen Fandom wiki today. The page fetch returned HTTP 402, and the API call was blocked. These heights come from memory of the character infoboxes.

tool_input.command: cd /tmp && for p in Yuta_Okkotsu Megumi_Fushiguro; do curl -s "https://jujutsu-kaisen.fandom.com/api.php?action=query&prop=revisions&rvprop=content&rvslots=main&format=json&titles=$p" | grep -o 'height[^\\]*' | head -3; done

reason: Megumi's height (175 cm) is correct, but the candidate names the wrong person as taller and gives Yuta's height as 168 cm instead of almost 180 cm.
